settings.permissions.intro: Choose how freely the agent runs tools, and inspect every approval decision in the permission prompt.

settings.permissions.sandbox.title: Command sandbox
settings.permissions.sandbox.desc: Restrict how shell commands and file tools touch the filesystem. Off keeps the default passthrough.
settings.permissions.sandbox.landlockNot: Full uses Linux Landlock (experimental) — it degrades loudly to Off where unavailable.
settings.permissions.sandbox.restartNote: Applies after you restart the app.
settings.permissions.rules.title: Rule syntax
settings.permissions.rules.intro: Profile rules use the same patterns as settings permission rules:
settings.permissions.rules.bare: matches the tool by name, e.g. every Bash call.
settings.permissions.rules.structured: matches the tool with a command pattern (* is a wildcard).
settings.permissions.rules.glob: glob patterns match tool names, e.g. MCP tools.
settings.permissions.rules.error.emptyTo: Tool name before “(” must not be empty.
settings.permissions.rules.error.toolWhi: Tool name must not contain spaces.
settings.permissions.editor.name: Profile name
